sources.title: Basic
sources.notes: Reused actual corpus receipt 2026-10-26T15:19:19.343926Z; no new fetch timestamp invented.

provenance.notes: Exact K005 Structures folder has DWG and CDR but no verified complete 3D assembly. Original files retained without claiming successful conversion. Family CAD upper retained unscaled; K002 lower and firmware are excluded.

sourceTransform.note: Source glass and LCD surfaces are separated3.294mm above the frame lip. A local rigid -3.2940483mm source-Y translation seats their lower face at frame top8.3mm; keys move -1mm source-Y to leave approximately0.48mm cap protrusion. These seating offsets are photo/CAD-estimated assembly, not manufacturer assembly constraints; raw source and transforms retained. Main frame geometry is unscaled.

familySnapshot.notes: Retained snapshot already includes the recorded global and local Gray-preview seating transforms. The additional [0,27,3] translation places the upper host in a photo-estimated kit layout; no rescaling.

limitations: 部分3D预览：Gray主机、长底座、35键QWERTY、20键计算器、8键Gamepad和独立充电座已分件；未达到完整工程装配精度。
原厂K005只找到DWG/CDR；上部借用明确标识的Core1家族CAD，Gray与底座的Z位置和面板外壳/键帽厚度为照片估计。
108×54×19mm是A009底座官方规格；58.2×54.2×10.4mm是单块Face面板规格。整套装配尺寸未确定；散件摆放尺寸不是产品尺寸。
35/20/8个按键分别有稳定物理ID和来源扫描映射，但目前只作外观；ATmega I2C、IRQ、充电、电池、IMU和音频未模拟。
内部板件UNKNOWN、螺钉/线束/隐藏插口未补猜。充电座只是照片可见外框近似，不能据此制作或插配实物。
未进行WebGL浏览器、照片同视角叠图、固件运行或实机验收；Node几何/材质检查不能替代这些验证。
representationScope: Included Gray upper family CAD + photo-derived A009 battery tray + mounted QWERTY + loose Calculator/Gamepad and charging dock. Cables, lanyard, hidden boards, screws and docking interfaces incomplete.
